description: This source file defines a Go package 'github' that provides functionality to retrieve the repository tree structure from GitHub repositories via the GitHub API. It includes data structures for representing tree entries and responses, and a function to create a tool for fetching and filtering repository trees.

classes.name: TreeEntryResponse
classes.description: Represents a single entry in a Git tree, including path, type, size, mode, SHA, and URL.

classes.name: TreeResponse
classes.description: Represents the response structure for a Git tree, including SHA, truncation status, list of entries, owner, repo, recursion flag, and count.

methods.name: GetRepositoryTree
methods.description: Creates a tool to retrieve the tree structure of a GitHub repository at a specific ref or SHA, with optional filtering and recursion.
